reserveReview.rationale: Plume documents pUSD as a non-interest-bearing USDC wrapper and identifies the Plume pUSD, native USDC, and legacy USDC.e contracts. At Ethereum block 25584897 (2026-07-22T01:10:35Z), pUSD totalSupply was 45,069.364229 and its BoringVault held 1,004,104.519629 native USDC. At Plume block 82560814 (2026-07-22T01:10:39Z), pUSD totalSupply was 4,924,317.169452 and its BoringVault held 3,469,873.680870 native USDC plus 495,408.331533 USDC.e. The two-chain aggregate is 4,969,386.533681 pUSD against 4,969,386.532032 USDC claims, a 0.001649-token difference (99.99999997% reconciliation). The collateral mix normalizes to 90.03% native USDC and 9.97% bridged USDC.e; the bridged slice is rated medium for the additional bridge contract path.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer-documented USDC-only composition reconciled from pUSD totalSupply and BoringVault token balances at timestamp-aligned Ethereum and Plume blocks
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No unresolved reserve constituent exposure in the issuer-documented and on-chain-reconciled composition.
